This week at a glance

New sample designs are posted on Instagram before the catalogue is locked. Every week the system pulls likes, saves, shares and comments, reads each comment for buying intent, and updates every design's scores.

Designs gaining engagement fastest compared with your account's normal level. Click any design for details.

Catalogue shortlist

Every candidate gets a single catalogue score that blends three signals. Move the sliders to set how much each one matters to your team; the shortlist re-ranks instantly. The top make the catalogue.

What people are saying

Each comment is read by an AI model that understands Hinglish and shorthand like “PP”, “rate?”, “COD hai?” and sorts it by intent. Price, size and order questions count as buying intent; praise alone does not.

How quality is checked, every season

1. Backtest

Before go-live, the model is trained on older seasons and asked to pick the most recent one. It ships only if it beats “pick by likes” and your team's own picks.

2. Shadow season

For the first season the system runs alongside your team. Both shortlists are recorded, and we compare sales of the designs only one side picked.

3. Learn from overrides

When your team overrules a score, the reason is logged. After each season the model is retrained, and comment-tagging is spot-checked on a sample of real comments.

How it works

A weekly pipeline that connects your social pages with your sales records. It runs automatically; your team sees a dashboard and a weekly summary.

1. Collect

  • Instagram & Facebook business pages (official Meta API)
  • WhatsApp catalogue enquiries
  • Sales & wholesaler orders (Tally / ERP / Excel export)
  • Design photos

2. Understand

  • AI reads comments in Hindi, English & Hinglish for buying intent
  • Image AI finds look-alike past designs
  • Engagement measured against your normal level

3. Score

  • Virality score
  • Buying-intent score
  • Sales potential: predicted wholesale units, learned from past seasons
  • One catalogue score, with your weights

4. Decide

  • Weekly dashboard & PDF / WhatsApp summary
  • Shortlist with the reasons behind every score
  • Wholesale leads list
  • Season review: what worked

Signals that drive the sales prediction

Share of the model's decisions explained by each signal group in this demo. With your data the mix will differ; it is shown to your team, never hidden.

What would be needed from you

Data

2–4 past seasons of design photos with design codes, and sales / wholesaler orders per design code (an Excel export is fine).

Access

Admin access to connect your Instagram/Facebook business account through Meta's official API, so there is no scraping.

Time

A 30-minute weekly review with the person who plans the catalogue, especially in the first season.
